title: Remake flanged joint 2"-P300-LS-3007/A2 on 2"-P300-LS-3007
notice: DEMONSTRATION ONLY — NOT A QUALIFIED PROCEDURE; THE FACILITY OWNER'S QUALIFIED PROCEDURES AND APPLICABLE CODES GOVERN.
reason: Steam leak at the tank heating-coil inlet flange.
scope: Isolate per the isolation list, drain and vent 2"-P300-LS-3007.
Break the joint at E 22'-0"  N -12"  EL 123'-9-1/4" between FLANGE WELD-NECK 2" P300 RAISED FACE and VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 2" P300.
Fit a new gasket and new studs; tighten to the stated preload in three passes, cross pattern (SW-WO-5).
Remove blinds; leak test on start-up (SW-TEST-2).

isolations.description: No valve on this side within the line: isolate the parent line 6"-P300-LS-2003 or depressure it under the shutdown isolation
Close and lock VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 2" P300 (2"-P300-LS-3007/B2)
Fit a line blind between 2"-P300-LS-3007/B2 and FLANGE WELD-NECK 2" P300 RAISED FACE (2"-P300-LS-3007/B5), work side

inspections.description: Flange faces before the new gasket goes in
inspections.criteria: No radial scratch across the sealing face (SW-NDE-5)

test.description: The remade joint checked at operating pressure on start-up

parts.description: STUD SET 4 × 0.625" × 4-1/4" WITH 2 NUTS, FOR 2" P300

itp.activity: Work permit issued; isolation list (valves locked, blinds fitted) verified at zero pressure and drained
itp.acceptance: Every isolation in place and tagged; zero pressure at the vent

itp.activity: Joint broken; both flange faces inspected
itp.acceptance: No radial scratch across the sealing face

itp.activity: New gasket fitted; studs tightened to preload in three passes
Blinds removed, isolations returned to normal line-up per the isolation list
itp.acceptance: Every blind removed and accounted for

itp.activity: Records complete; work order handed back to operations
itp.acceptance: All ITP activities accepted or not applicable
